name: mc_snapshot
title: Snapshot region
description:
Saves a region (block states, sign text and decorative entities; not inventories) for mc_restore, lists stored snapshots, or lists and deletes build journal entries (every writing mc_build, mc_repair and mc_restore keeps one).

WHEN TO USE: one restore point before several separate mc_build calls in an area (mc_build snapshot:true covers only that call); before something destructive; to find snapshot ids, or (journal-list touches) which calls changed an area.
WHEN NOT TO USE: to read blocks (mc_inspect; snapshots are not displayed). Not again after mc_build snapshot:true for the same region.

PARAMETERS: action "create" (default) needs from/to (at most 200,000 blocks) and an optional label. "list" returns every snapshot. "journal-list" returns entries newest first (id, time, tool, world, bounds, changed cells, label, undo links), filtered by since, label, world, touches and limit (default 50). "journal-delete" removes entry `id`.

SIDE EFFECTS: create reads the region and uses one snapshot slot; the oldest snapshot is evicted silently when the configured maximum is reached. journal-delete removes the undo record, not the blocks. Nothing else changes.

world.description: World for create (default: the configured default world), or a journal-list filter.

label.description: create: a note such as "before tower"; journal-list: case-insensitive substring filter.

id.description: journal-delete: the journal id to remove.

since.description: journal-list: entries at or after this ISO-8601 UTC instant.

touches.description: journal-list: entries that changed a cell inside this inclusive box.
